stratagems.name: Benediction of the Omnissiah
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 6 scores 1 additional hit.

stratagems.name: Protector Doctrina Imperative
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that was selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Save characteristic of models in your unit by 1.

stratagems.name: Overwatch
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit declares a charge.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that was selected as the target of that charge.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can shoot that charging unit as if it were your Shooting phase. When doing so, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit.

stratagems.name: Shroud Psalms
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has the Stealth ability.

stratagems.name: Data-Spike
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS INFANTRY unit from your army that made a charge move, was charged, or performed a Heroic Intervention this turn.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, on an unmodified Wound roll of 6, that attack has an Armour Penetration characteristic of -4.
